verdict.rationale: Formant offers a Python Cloud SDK, an Agent SDK, and a JS/TS-based RealtimeSDK/toolkit for building custom apps, but there is no evidence of official Go or C++ SDKs, nor any claim that these are strongly typed or cover the platform's 'full surface' (fleet orchestration, analytics, teleop APIs are referenced mostly via REST/Admin API, not dedicated SDKs). missing for 10: Go SDK, C++ SDK, explicit typing guarantees, and full API-surface coverage beyond telemetry/commands/data export.
